question: How do I reset my password if I no longer have access to my email?
reference: Contact support with your account ID and a photo ID; identity verification takes up to 24 hours, then support updates the recovery email.
a: Contact support with your account ID and a photo ID. After identity verification (up to 24 hours) we update your recovery email so you can reset your password.
b: Just click forgot password and check your email.

question: Can I get a refund on an annual plan after 20 days?
reference: Annual plans are refundable in full within 30 days of purchase; after 30 days, refunds are prorated only for service outages.
a: I think refunds are maybe possible, you could probably ask billing.
b: Yes. Annual plans are refundable in full within 30 days of purchase, so at 20 days you qualify. Request it under Billing > Refund.

question: Why was my shipment delayed and when will it arrive?
reference: Carrier shows a weather hold at the Memphis hub; new estimated delivery is Thursday. Customer can track with the carrier link.
a: There is a weather hold at the Memphis hub. Your new estimated delivery is Thursday, and the carrier tracking link will update.
b: Your package was held at the Memphis hub due to weather; the carrier now estimates Thursday delivery. Tracking updates via the carrier link.

question: Does the Pro plan include SSO?
reference: SSO (SAML) is included in Enterprise only. Pro customers can add it for $4 per user per month.
a: SSO with SAML is included in Enterprise. On Pro you can add SSO for $4 per user per month.
b: Pro includes SSO, SAML and SCIM at no extra cost, plus unlimited audit logs and premium support for every user on the plan, which obviously covers most security reviews.

question: How do I export my data to CSV?
reference: Go to Reports, choose the date range, click Export and pick CSV; files over 1M rows are emailed as a zip.
a: Open Reports, choose a date range, click Export and pick CSV. Exports over 1M rows are emailed to you as a zip.
b: In Reports pick the date range, then Export > CSV. Big exports (over 1M rows) arrive by email as a zip file.

question: My invoice shows a charge for 12 seats but we only have 9 users. Why?
reference: Seats are billed on the peak count during the billing period; deactivated users still count until the period ends. Remove seats in Admin > Billing to lower the next invoice.
a: Seats bill on the peak count in the billing period, so users you deactivated still count until the period ends. Remove unused seats in Admin > Billing to lower the next invoice.
b: You were simply overcharged, we will refund the 3 seats.

question: Is my data encrypted at rest?
reference: Yes, AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit; customer-managed keys are available on Enterprise.
a: Yes. Data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2+. Enterprise can use customer-managed keys.
b: Yes, AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.2 or newer in transit. Customer-managed keys are an Enterprise option.

question: How long does a bank transfer payout take?
reference: Payouts reach US bank accounts in 2 business days and EU accounts in 3; the first payout can take up to 7 days for verification.
a: Payouts arrive in 2 business days for US banks and 3 for EU banks. Your first payout can take up to 7 days while we verify the account.
b: Payouts take a while depending on your bank.

question: Can I change the delivery address after my order shipped?
reference: Once shipped, the address can be changed only through the carrier's redirect service, which may add a fee; otherwise refuse delivery and we reship after it returns.
a: After shipping you can request a carrier redirect, which may add a fee. Or refuse delivery and we reship once it comes back.
b: Once shipped, use the carrier's redirect service (a fee may apply), or refuse the delivery and we will reship after it returns to us.

question: Why is the API returning 429 errors?
reference: 429 means the rate limit of 100 requests per second per key was exceeded; back off using the Retry-After header or request a higher limit.
a: A 429 means you exceeded the rate limit of 100 requests per second per key. Back off using the Retry-After header, or ask us for a higher limit.
b: 429 is a server error on our side, maybe try again later.

question: Do you support two-factor authentication?
reference: Yes: authenticator apps and hardware security keys (WebAuthn). Admins can enforce 2FA for the whole workspace.
b: Yes. You can use an authenticator app or a hardware security key (WebAuthn), and admins can enforce two-factor authentication for the whole workspace.

question: What happens to my data if I cancel?
reference: Data is kept read-only for 30 days after cancellation, then permanently deleted; export anytime before deletion.
a: Your data stays read-only for 30 days after you cancel, then it is permanently deleted. Export it any time before then.
b: After cancellation, data is read-only for 30 days and then permanently deleted, so export what you need before that.
